name: whalescope-mcp
install: npm ci && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply whalescope-mcp-db --local

terminals.name: wrangler-dev
terminals.description: Cloudflare Worker (whalescope-mcp) local dev server. Status page at http://localhost:8787/ and MCP endpoint at http://localhost:8787/mcp. Binance-native tools need PROXY_URL/PROXY_SECRET (bridged from Cloud Agent secrets into .dev.vars by the start command); without them they return a clear 'PROXY_URL belum diset' error while KV/D1-backed tools still work with local bindings.
